cosmic parser

phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.justification: forward morphism to apply stellar lexicon to quantum syntax

AREV.justification: reverse transformation to validate or reject cosmic syntax

CLINK.justification: chaining of semantic transformations and validation steps

ENGAGR.justification: simultaneous holding of valid and invalid states in cosmic parsing

EVALF.justification: negative branch where cosmic syntax is rejected

EVALT.justification: affirmative branch where cosmic syntax is validated

FFUSE.justification: reconstitute the original cosmic syntax from split branches

FSPLIT.justification: split into true/affirmative and false/negative parsing paths

IFIX.justification: irreversible record of all parsed cosmic syntax

IMSCRIB.justification: identity operation for self-referential cosmic syntax

TANCH.justification: the boundary that contains all cosmic parsing operations

VINIT.justification: void state before any cosmic syntax is recognized

phase_3.both_description: both_states_hold — simultaneous presence of valid and invalid states in parsing
phase_3.false_description: invalid_quantum_form — cosmic syntax fails validation or interpretation
phase_3.true_description: valid_stellar_syntax — cosmic syntax is correctly interpreted and validated
phase_3.void_description: empty_stellar_grammar — no cosmic syntax has been recognized yet

steps.domain_action: empty_stellar_grammar initializes before any cosmic syntax is processed
cosmic_branching splits into true/affirmative and false/negative parsing paths
valid_stellar_syntax confirms cosmic syntax is correctly interpreted
semantic_transformation applies stellar lexicon to quantum syntax
sequential_parsing chains validation and transformation steps
invalid_quantum_form rejects cosmic syntax as incorrect or uninterpretable
descent_analysis reverses the parsing process for validation feedback
universal_synthesis reconstitutes original cosmic syntax from split branches
permanent_cosmic_log records all parsed cosmic syntax permanently
universal_constant closes the system with final parsed output

phase_5.alfs_store: universal_constant_alf serves as canonical reference for cosmic parsing
phase_5.compiler_frontend: cosmic_code_compiler translates domain intentions into parsing operations
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: quantum_message_passing how components communicate within the system
phase_5.memory_mechanism: stellar_lexicon_cache stores and retrieves stellar lexicons efficiently
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: universal_scheduling_algorithm determines order and timing of parsing steps

phase_6.cycle_cost: semantic_transformation — energy consumed in applying stellar lexicon
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — parsing operations maintain entropy balance through validation, transformation, and logging
phase_6.post_cycle_state: permanent_cosmic_log — after all parsed syntax is recorded
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: empty_stellar_grammar — before any cosmic syntax is processed
